title: School-mallports
content: I had a dream maybe a year ago where it was a typical set-up, a mall with aspects of a school and airport. I was with some people I knew from HS (and one of them had a receding hairline for some reason). Inbetween classes, there would be a circle you'd have to stay in, like a battle royale video game. It was a free for all- I don't remember any shooting or anything, but all I had was my friends. We camped in a kiosk with turrets to defend us as we ate lunch. Yes I know this sounds jacked up, especially with some particular recent events in the US, but I have no idea what my brain was trying to convey there. I've had other dreams where it's a mallport with stores serving as classrooms. The dreams weren't very vivid but I always remember them. I've also been having dreams I get stuck in TSA for some reason or another. I've flown a couple times recently and airports are just an unnerving, stressful experience. When I was a kid it was just one large liminal space, but now that I'm an adult the place is scary. Doesn't help that I go to the DIA which has fucked up paintings and runways arranged as swastikas and shit. No real point to make here, other than I relate to the mallworld experience. I think it might have something to do with malls and airports being these strangely liminal spaces you don't usually go to. I can't describe it other than limimal, but idk. Random but I would love to rent the DIA for a day and have a 2,000 man hide and seek royale.
